pdf.officeProjection.documentIncluded: Reading order, headings, lists, paragraphs, tables with their drawn borders and shading, and pictures and text boxes in their place become editable Word content; backgrounds and cover art sit behind the text and chart labels stay editable text. A scanned page keeps its image; OCR text you have accepted becomes its lines.
pdf.officeProjection.documentLoss: Text-box annotations become text boxes; other annotations stay as part of the page picture; forms and links are not converted; complex artwork such as charts and diagrams is kept as a picture under its labels; fonts the PDF does not name get the Office font closest to their character widths.
pdf.officeProjection.spreadsheetIncluded: Each PDF page becomes a worksheet. Columns follow where text starts on the page, a label and its value on one line land in neighbouring cells, and tables keep merged cells, borders and shading. Pictures are placed at their rows.
pdf.officeProjection.spreadsheetLoss: Numbers are stored as numbers with their format (thousands, decimals, negatives in brackets, percent, currency); no formulas are invented, and drawings that are not tables are not converted.
pdf.officeProjection.presentationInclude: Each PDF page becomes a slide: text becomes editable text boxes, drawn tables become PowerPoint tables, and pictures, colour bands and frames are kept.
pdf.officeProjection.presentationLoss: Text-box annotations become text boxes; other annotations stay as part of the page picture; forms, links, transitions and animations are not converted; complex vector artwork is kept as a picture.
